title: Stop Translating in Your Head! Do This Instead #shorts
description:
How to stop translating in your head and think in English: name what you see.
• One word: coffee
• Two words: hot coffee
• A sentence: I'm drinking hot coffee.

Do it with everything around you, a few times a day. What do you see right now? Write it in English in the comments.
